description: Trusted K-12 CMS / content-host domain SUFFIXES (matched via endsWith). Two uses: (1) Stage 2 discover.py gate() keeps an off-domain candidate whose host ends with one of these AND contains the district slug -- LOAD-BEARING for discovery recall (a Tier-2 effect, only re-measurable by re-running discovery); (2) Stage 3 cms_hint = host-suffix match against this list (a Tier-0 recompute via `capture_discovery.mjs recompute-cms-hint`, no re-capture). Single source of truth for BOTH discover.py and capture_discovery.mjs (REQ-089, ending the prior hand-synced dual definition).
governance: Every addition is a human-in-the-loop decision, never automated. Each entry MUST be a vendor that specifically serves school districts -- NEVER a general hosting/CDN provider (amazonaws.com is deliberately excluded despite core-docs.s3.amazonaws.com appearing in real data: S3 hosts everything, so whitelisting it would invite pollution).
